title: DEPRECATED_Type Casting

lines.explanation: a double value cannot be directly assigned to a float variable. Typecasting is required
To assign double or float value to a a variable of an integer type you need to typecast this value. This will truncate the floating part of the double value.

To convert from a longer integer type to a shorter integer type a typecasting is also required. As in all cases above some information can be lost. For example here if the value of i is not between -128 and 127, the resulting value of b will be different from the expected.
